protocol.scope: One synthetic 118x1024 window of the reviewed preset through Calculator.compute, per-metric elapsed_seconds from the metric reports; excludes loading, preprocessing and output writing.
protocol.input_generation: tests/benchmark_run_hotspots.py synthetic(): AR(1) with 0.6 self and 0.2 neighbour coupling, numpy.random.default_rng(0).
protocol.statistic: Median over repeats (baseline 2, after 3) of total and per-metric wall time.
protocol.limits: Synthetic inputs on a shared machine with other jobs; not a patient or cohort throughput estimate. The baseline receipt is the same branch before any change in this series.

preset.reason: Identical to prec_MinCovDet / prec-sq_MinCovDet once both estimators serve from one seeded FAST-MCD fit (user decision 2026-10-28).

prec_EllipticEnvelope.change: EllipticEnvelope serves from the cached MinCovDet fit (basic._fit_name); sklearn EllipticEnvelope.fit is MinCovDet.fit plus offset_, never read.
prec_EllipticEnvelope.output: bit-identical goldens (8 robust identifiers, small and full, max_abs 0)

cov_MinCovDet.change: pyspi._robust.FastMinCovDet: FAST-MCD C-steps take Mahalanobis distances and log-determinant from one Cholesky factor (pseudo-inverse fallback when not positive definite); fixed random_state = basic.ROBUST_RANDOM_STATE = 42 (harness seed).
cov_MinCovDet.equivalence: Same seed: raw_support_ and support_ identical to sklearn 1.9.1 MinCovDet on five synthetic sets (tests/unit/test_robust.py) and on the 118x1024 benchmark window (max relative covariance/precision difference 0.0; standalone fit 3.92 s -> 1.24 s).
cov_MinCovDet.output: bit-identical goldens; a rounding-induced support change remains possible in principle and would show as a tolerance-level difference

spectral_phase_family.change: Phase classes register their taper moments (PHASE_MOMENTS) before compute, like directed requests; the first request forms every registered moment in one _reduce_phase pass and the workspace's retained-array budget grows to fit the registered moments and one measure result per family (SpectralConnectivity.reserve_phase_moments).
spectral_phase_family.output: bit-identical: Calculator pass versus per-class fresh Data (tests/unit/test_phase_lag.py) and all multitaper goldens (small and full)

cov_GraphicalLassoCV.profile: 4.46 s = 80 sklearn _graphical_lasso fits (4 refinements x 5 folds x 4 alphas) + final fit, ~54 ms each; pinvh 0.25 s. n_jobs over folds would cut wall time only; a compiled solver is unverified.
